name: public-sample
description: CANDIDATE: not yet executed. No numbers may be quoted for this dataset until a run directory produced by benchmark/run.ts exists and is cited. 12 public websites across categories, chosen because they are built for or known to tolerate automated access: dedicated test/demo and scraping-sandbox sites (saucedemo, demo.vercel.store, toscrape.com), public documentation sites, open-source project pages, public institutions and reference sites. Every entry uses the built-in read-only task archetypes ("tasks": "default"). The runner uses an honest user agent and respects robots.txt; do not add sites whose terms forbid automated access.
